752:t_3:87.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Besides, isn't it thrilling to watch the end of that $$御使い$$'s... no, of $$アドヴェント#pilot$$'s ambitions, which reached even higher?」

752:t_3:88.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You really are beyond saving.」

752:t_3:90.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「It seems so. You've made that abundantly clear.」

752:t_3:92.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Farewell, $n. As you said, it seems there is no place for me, however many worlds I search.」

752:t_3:93.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「So I will watch the universe enter its new age from outside the natural order.」

752:t_3:95.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You need not forgive me.」

752:t_3:98.en:
$n
「From now on, humanity will surely evolve and attain $$シンカ$$ over a long time... Perhaps someday we'll become higher-dimensional beings...」

752:t_3:99.en:
$n
「But we won't become beings who rule over other people's fates or lives.」

752:t_3:100.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「If that is the future you have chosen, I have nothing to say as I depart.」

752:t_3:101.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I can only bless the future of those who overcame the obstacle that I was.」

752:t_3:102.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You really do look down on everyone right up to the very end...」

752:t_3:103.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Shall we go, then, $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$? Let the man who sought godhood and the man called a devil exit the stage here.」

752:t_3:104.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Goodbye, $n. Please give my regards to everyone.」

752:t_3:105.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「In a world where gods and devils have vanished... humans are what remain.」

752:t_3:106.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「May your future be filled with happiness!」

752:t_3:109.en:
$n
「In a world without gods or devils, let's decide for ourselves where we'll go...」

753:t_001:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「Where did $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ go!?」

753:t_001:2.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Maybe he was destroyed along with $$エス・テラン$$...」

753:t_001:3.en:
$$刹那$$
「I don't think we can count on that...! They're coming!」

753:t_002:0.en:
$$葵$$
「The $$御使い$$s' servants are still here!」

753:t_002:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So the forces deployed to other worlds have returned!」

753:t_002:2.en:
$$真徒$$
「What a disaster! $$エス・テラン$$ is...!」

753:t_002:3.en:
$$真徒$$
「Oh...! Lord $$ドクトリン$$, Lord $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, Lady $$サクリファイ$$, Lady $$テンプティ$$!」

753:t_002:4.en:
$$真徒$$
「Guide us...! Please guide us, your lost followers!」

753:t_002:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
(There is no need to worry.)

753:t_002:8.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
(Promising eternity... That is the duty of the $$御使い$$s, and my duty.)

753:t_002:9.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
(But there are those who would destroy that eternity.)

753:t_002:11.en:
$$真徒$$
「Leave it to us, Lord $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! We will exterminate the Earthlings!」

753:t_002:13.en:
$$ランド$$
「Wake up already, all of you!」

753:t_002:14.en:
$$ガロード$$
「If you keep obeying the $$御使い$$s blindly, everything in the universe will end!」

753:t_002:15.en:
$$真徒$$
「Inferior species! How could the likes of you understand the hearts of the Exalted Ones!?」

753:t_002:16.en:
$$真徒$$
「You're just howling because you weren't chosen! You're pitiful losers who will never reach eternity!」

753:t_002:17.en:
$$ロラン$$
「The $$御使い$$s you believe in were wiped out by $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

753:t_002:18.en:
$$レド$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$ destroyed $$エス・テラン$$ too! Do you still believe in him!?」

753:t_002:19.en:
$$真徒$$
「All universes shall receive salvation at the hands of the Supreme God's emissaries!」

753:t_002:20.en:
$$真徒$$
「Chant the word of salvation! Salus!」

753:t_002:21.en:
$$シン$$
「It's no use...! Words won't reach them anymore!」

753:t_002:22.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We'll break through them and head for $$エス・テラン$$! $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ must be there!」

753:t_002:23.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, begin attacking! We'll defeat the $$真徒$$s and stop $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

753:t_002:24.en:
$$甲児$$
「If we don't defeat him, the universe's great collapse will happen...!」

753:t_002:25.en:
$$タケル$$
「Instead of stopping the great collapse, he spoke as if he were waiting for it!」

753:t_002:26.en:
$n
「We have to hurry...! Otherwise, every universe will end!」

753:t_003:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It's him...! It's definitely $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

753:t_003:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「The time of rebirth has come. Now the bells of blessing ring out proudly.」

753:t_003:3.en:
$n
「What are you going to do, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!?」

753:t_003:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「The Heavenly Prison has been destroyed... Here, a new universe announces its beginning.」

753:t_004:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I confirm distortion of the dimensional boundaries. However, its pattern is completely different from any previously observed.」

753:t_004:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I cannot infer it. All sensors have completely ceased functioning.」

753:t_005:0.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I detect a tremendous surge of $$次元力|lc$$! It far exceeds $$プロディキウム$$ or $$シュロウガ$$!」

753:t_007:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「B-big doesn't even begin to describe it!」

753:t_007:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Yes. This is hope and salvation made manifest... the new Supreme God.」

753:t_007:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「And here is where the old world ends and the new world begins... The planet that will become the end of myth.」

753:t_007:5.en:
$$勝平$$
「A planet!? Are you talking about the shattered $$エス・テラン$$!?」

753:t_008:1.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「But $$スヴェル$$ is gone!」

753:t_008:2.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Did the intense drain on $$次元力|lc$$ cause it to reach its operating limit earlier than projected!?」

753:t_008:3.en:
$$五飛$$
「We're in a world where $$エス・テラン$$ and our Earth exist together...!」

753:t_008:4.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「What in the world is happening!?」

753:t_008:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$カオス・コスモス$$ and $$エス・テラン$$ have collapsed. Yes... The Heavenly Prison has vanished.」
